layout_source_citations.quote: /// Serialized offsets are recovered from 0x685f0 and 0x68ce0.
/// Neutral field names avoid claiming unavailable historical semantics.

fields.name: field_8
fields.role: Creation timestamp of the state account: the Unix timestamp at which initialize_mayhem_state ran.
behavior: Written exactly once in recovered source, by the initializer, to the current Clock timestamp.
No recovered handler reads it. No second writer exists in the pinned corpus.
On chain, the one fully decoded state stores at offset 8 the exact blockTime of its creation transaction (1,764,874,513), corroborating the creation-timestamp reading.

writers.site: lib.rs initialize_mayhem_state

crosswalk.note: The repo crosswalk records zero field_8 occurrences and corrects twelve historical field_8 rows that were substring matches on field_89. Its lib.rs admission excluded the initializer span, so the initializer write above is outside its corpus, not in conflict with it.

fields.unresolved_part: Whether the original binary ever reads offset 8 after creation. A reader could only sit in a window with no recovered source (see the unresolved register). The stored value and its writer are not in doubt; a later consumer is.

fields.name: end_timestamp
fields.role: End of the Mayhem trading window for this state: creation time plus the GlobalParams field_6 duration in hours, in seconds.
behavior: Computed by the initializer as now + duration_hours * 3600, where duration_hours is read from the GlobalParams field_6 slot.
Every trade body rejects at or after it (MayhemModeEnded). The burn requires it to have passed (MayhemModeNotEnded, 6005) before it may run.
Emitted in every trade event.

fields.name: mint
fields.role: The mint this state account belongs to, copied from the mint account at creation.
behavior: Written once by the initializer from the mint account key.

No recovered handler reads the stored copy. Every handler instead receives the mint as its own account and derives the state PDA from it (seeds [b"mayhem-state", mint]), so the stored copy is informational in the recovered code.
Whether the original binary validates against the stored copy anywhere is not inferable from recovered source; the crosswalk says the same.

fields.name: field_56
fields.role: Per-coin signed net quote deployment for this state: quote currency (SOL in the legacy bodies, the trade's quote amount in the v2 and pump-swap bodies) measured as deployed into this curve, buys adding and sells subtracting.
behavior: Initialized to 0. Every buy adds the measured quote amount with checked i128 arithmetic; every sell subtracts it.

On buy paths only, after the update, a positive field_56 is compared against the per-coin deployment limit (GlobalParams field_5 native, field_13 non-native): the limit must strictly exceed field_56 or the trade fails with CoinRiskExceeded. The comparison truncates field_56 to its low u64 limb, a quirk the recovered buy code comments on explicitly.
Sells do not re-run the limit check.

Emitted in every trade event twice, as state_sol_deployed and as state_quote_deployed, except that the v2 and pump-swap bodies report state_sol_deployed as 0 on non-native trades while state_quote_deployed always carries the value.
Signedness is real, not decorative: the decoded on-chain state holds field_56 = -137,977,914 after its full lifecycle, so sells can drive the accumulator below zero.

The mirrored GlobalParams accumulator (sol_deployed / stable_deployed) is updated in the same handlers with the same amounts, split by native versus non-native accounting; field_56 is the per-state counterpart that the per-coin limit reads.

fields.name: field_72
fields.role: Signed net token accounting for this state: tokens returned to the curve by sells minus tokens taken out by buys, in raw token units.
behavior: Initialized to 0. Every buy subtracts the actual tokens received; every sell adds the actual tokens sent. Checked i128 arithmetic.
No handler gates on it. Its only readers are the trade events, which emit it as state_token_net on both native and non-native trades.
The decoded on-chain state holds 7,003,298,844,045 after a lifecycle whose last trades were net sells back into the curve, consistent with the sign convention.

fields.name: flag_88
fields.role: No role is attributable from the recovered sources or the retained chain evidence.
behavior: Written exactly once, by the initializer, to false.

No recovered handler in the full pinned corpus (lib.rs, state.rs, all eight instruction modules, checked_program.rs, mod.rs, pump_swap_types.rs) reads or writes it again. The exact-token search that establishes this is the same discipline the repo crosswalk uses, and the crosswalk independently records zero occurrences.
The codec accepts only 0 or 1 at this offset (state.rs comment).

The one fully decoded on-chain state, which was created, traded, expired and burned, holds 0. A single lifecycle cannot distinguish a never-used flag from one set only by code with no recovered source.

fields.name: field_89
fields.role: Timestamp of the last committed trade on this state, the per-state clock for the GlobalParams field_7 trade interval (rate limit).
behavior: Initialized to the creation timestamp.

Every trade body reads it first: when it is nonzero and the GlobalParams field_7 interval is nonzero, the trade requires now >= field_89 + interval or fails with TradeRateLimit. The body then rewrites it to now before pricing, so a reverted trade does not move it and a committed trade always does.
In the decoded on-chain state it sits 48 seconds after creation (field_8), the mark of a state whose last committed trade landed 48 seconds in.

fields.name: status
fields.role: Lifecycle stage of the state: Variant0 before the first trade, Variant1 after the first trade passes the minimum-reserve gate, Ended after the terminal burn.
behavior: The initializer sets Variant0.

Every trade body, before pricing, checks whether status is not yet Variant1; if so it requires the bonding curve's real reserves to meet the minimum threshold (GlobalParams field_9 native, field_14 non-native) or fails with SolReservesTooLow, and sets Variant1. Later trades skip the check.
The burn requires status not equal to Ended (a second burn fails with MayhemModeEnded, 6004) and sets Ended as its last write. Ended is terminal: no transition leaves it in recovered source.

Trade bodies do not test for Ended directly. They do not need to: the burn can only run after end_timestamp, and every trade requires now < end_timestamp, so an Ended state is unreachable by trades on the recovered code paths.
The codec accepts only 0, 1 or 2 at this offset.

fields.name: burned_amount
fields.role: Amount of tokens burned by the terminal burn: the full mayhem token vault balance at burn time.
behavior: Initialized to 0.

The burn handler reads the mayhem token vault's full amount, burns exactly that amount through the token program, and assigns it to burned_amount (assignment, not accumulation; a second burn is impossible because the same handler sets status to Ended and rejects re-entry).
Also emitted in the BurnEvent.
The decoded on-chain state holds 992,996,701,155,955, the vault balance its burn consumed.

cross_check_against_284.pair: GlobalParams field_6 (duration_hours, strongly indicated in PR #284) and MayhemState end_timestamp
cross_check_against_284.detail: The initializer computes end_timestamp from the field_6 slot; the decoded state shows end_timestamp minus field_8 equal to exactly 86,400 seconds at the proven field_6 value of 24. The #284 phase 2 check used offsets 8 and 16 of this same account; this package identifies offset 8 as field_8 and attributes it.

cross_check_against_284.pair: GlobalParams field_7 (per-state trade interval) and MayhemState field_89
cross_check_against_284.detail: #284 describes field_7 as the interval checked against MayhemState.field_89. All six trade bodies perform exactly that check and rewrite field_89. Note the interval was 0 at every proven GlobalParams version, so the rate limit has never been armed on chain; the contract is source-side.

cross_check_against_284.pair: GlobalParams field_5 / field_13 (per-coin deployment limits) and MayhemState field_56
cross_check_against_284.detail: #284 lists field_56 as the quantity the per-coin limit gates. The buy bodies gate on field_56 with the native limit from field_5 storage and the non-native limit from field_13 storage, matching the #284 native and non-native families.

cross_check_against_284.pair: GlobalParams field_9 / field_14 (minimum reserve thresholds) and the MayhemState status Variant1 transition
cross_check_against_284.detail: #284 attributes preserved_middle_a (field_9) as gating the Variant1 transition on minimum real reserves. The trade bodies do exactly this, with field_14 storage as the non-native threshold in the v2 and pump-swap bodies.

cross_check_against_284.pair: MayhemState field_56 sign behavior and the recovered buy code's truncation comment
cross_check_against_284.detail: buy.rs comments that the original tests signed positivity and then compares the low u64 limb with a strict upper bound, preserving the truncation for counters beyond u64. The decoded state holds field_56 negative (-137,977,914), which the positivity test handles by skipping the limit check; no tension with #284, whose field_5 entry describes the same gate.

governance.basis: docs/COMPLETION.md (current checkpoint) names the stopped executions; MayhemState field attribution is not among them, and its historical checkpoint names the neutral MayhemState fields as unresolved. docs/REMAINING-WORK.md (Mayhem non-initializer ABI/state row) sets the outcome: resolve fields and full error/data contracts.
governance.boundaries: Static attribution and read-only chain reads only. The recovered initializer body is read as merged evidence and never executed. No candidate build, no differential execution, no runtime probe. The paused sweep lane (O0073, O0075, O0076) is not entered; its bodies are named only as places an unattributed consumer could hide.
